findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 1440px: "Tu negocio necesita una plataforma digital que t" → 5 lines (10 words, 60.8px); "No construimos páginas web. Construimos motores " → 5 lines (12 words, 48px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 36px or less.

findings.message: 8 eyebrow/kicker label(s) above headings: "Así trabajamos juntos" above "Empezar es más fácil de lo que crees."; "El problema que frena tu crecimiento" (pill) above "Tu negocio merece más que un sitio web g"; "Nuestra propuesta de valor" above "No construimos páginas web. Construimos "; "Lo que podemos hacer por ti" (pill) above "Soluciones digitales que impulsan tu neg"; "Stack tecnológico" above "Tecnología de"
findings.fix: Delete them. If the label carried real information, fold it into the headline or the supporting sentence.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: ui-monospace — e.g. "NUXT", "VUE", "REACT", "NODE"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.

findings.message: Decorative index numbers: "01", "02", "03", "04", "01", "02"
findings.fix: Remove them. If order truly matters, write it into the words ("First, …") or use a real <ol>.

findings.message: 27 tiny uppercase letter-spaced labels (e.g. "Así trabajamos juntos", "El problema que frena tu crecimiento", "Nuestra propuesta de valor", "Lo que podemos hacer por ti").
findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.

findings.message: Emoji in the page: ⚡ 🎯 🔒 🤝 ♥ 💡
findings.fix: Remove. Use words or real imagery.

findings.message: 14 gradient fill(s): div.absolute.-top-60 → radial-gradient(circle, rgb(29, 95, 166) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%) | div.absolute.bottom-0 → radial-gradient(circle, rgb(29, 95, 166) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 70%) | div.absolute.inset-8 → radial-gradient(at 60% 50%, rgba(29, 95, 166, 0.1) 0%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 65%)
findings.fix: Use a flat colour or a real image. The only gradient allowed by default is a neutral scrim over a photo for legibility.

findings.message: 1 gradient-filled text element(s).
findings.fix: Solid colour text.

findings.message: 4 box-shadow(s) on elements at rest: div.relative.w-full → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 0px 32px 80px 0px, rgba(16, 43, 70, 0.04) 0px 0px 0px 1px | div.absolute.-top-5 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) 0px 16px 40px 0px | div.absolute.-bottom-5 → rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4) 0px 16px 40px 0px
findings.fix: Remove. Separate surfaces with a tone step or space. Shadows are for things that really float (menus, dialogs, sticky bars).

findings.message: Buttons with shadow/glow.
findings.fix: Flat fill, one colour.

findings.message: 14 thin rule(s)/divider line(s): div.site-container.border-b 1267px | div.hero-enter.delay-4 550px | div.flex.items-center 598px | div.flex.flex-col 140px
findings.fix: Delete. Separate with space, a tone change, or scale. Lines are only for real tables and form fields.

findings.message: 16 boxes drawn with a 1px outline.
findings.fix: Define a surface by its fill (one tone step from the page) or leave the content unboxed.

findings.message: 2 backdrop-blur surfaces.
findings.fix: One blurred sticky bar at most; glass cards are a tell.

findings.message: 3 row(s) of identical cards each topped with a small icon (3, 4, 3 cards).
findings.fix: Replace with one composed section from the direction: a narrative split, a list set in large type, or real imagery per item.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: Body text is 14px (the size most of the running text is set in).
findings.fix: Body copy 16–20px. Map small sizes from blueprints onto your body step.

findings.message: The running text is a soft grey on its ground (5.5:1).
findings.fix: Set body copy in the full ink (7:1 or more). Keep the muted ink for secondary notes; pages read thin and unfinished when everything is grey.

findings.message: Only 0 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 0 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: 50 text blocks under 13px.
findings.fix: Nothing meant to be read goes below 13px.

findings.message: The first screen has no dominant element: the largest type is 60.8px (4.2vw) and no single picture holds a third of the viewport.
findings.fix: Make one thing lead: the headline at display size, or one large picture. A grid of many small pictures is not one thing; in blind tests jurors marked a first screen without a headline down every time. On the strongest studied sites the largest type has a median of 8.4vw.
